result.topic_en: The page concludes a table giving, for primes 5, 7 and 11, the linear forms of primes for which +p and -p are quadratic residues or non-residues, remarks that proofs of these theorems would greatly advance number theory, and begins Theorem 92 on powers of exponent lambda.
